title: Text to image
notes: Anchor example, in world 1: the skyharbor courier. Its output image is the source the img2img, controlnet and inpainting flows start from, and the before-image for facefix. Those flows read it from inputs/, so regenerating this one means re-staging inputs/tutorial-anchor-1024.webp and inputs/tutorial-anchor-512.webp before they are regenerated. The subject descriptor block is byte-identical to the batch's w1 block wherever the courier appears.
